reasons.claim: Qatada and Ayyub are co-transmitters from Sa'id, both handing on to Salih Abi al-Khalil.
reasons.quote: حدثنا سعيد، عن قتادة، وأيوب، عن صالح أبي الخليل

reasons.claim: The chain ends at Umm al-Fadl, who relays the Prophet's answer.
reasons.quote: عن أم الفضل، أن نبي الله

reasons.claim: Qatada's alternative wording at the end is a wording remark and adds no route.
reasons.quote: وقال قتادة

reasons.claim: The chain runs through al-Qasim b. Muslim to his brother Abd al-Aziz b. Muslim.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَني القاسِم بْنِ مُسْلِم، عَن أَخِيهِ عَبْد العَزِيز بْنِ مُسْلِم

reasons.claim: In the narrated encounter the Imam speaks to Abd al-Aziz, so he is the last link (ruling 9).
reasons.quote: فَتَبَسَّمَ ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا عَبْدَ الْعَزِيزِ

reasons.claim: The Imam is named in the story's words after the chain.
reasons.quote: كُنَّا فِي أَيَّامِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسَى الرِّضَا

reviews.question: Whether the editor's bracketed «[عن زائدة]» between Zakariyya and Zadhan is a link of the chain; the readers leave it out, the stored chain keeps it.

reasons.claim: The text carries a bracketed editorial insertion of a further link between two transmitters.
reasons.quote: عن زكريا بن ابي زائدة [عن زائدة]، عن زاذان

reasons.claim: Apart from that point, the readers' route is right and ends at Muhammad b. al-Hanafiyya, whom Zirr heard.
reasons.quote: عن زر بن حبيش قال: سمعت محمد بن الحنفى

reasons.claim: The place after the first shaykh is not part of a link.
reasons.quote: الفقيه بمرو الروذ

reviews.uncertainty_note: If the bracketed link is accepted, «زائدة» stands between «زكريا بن ابي زائدة» and «زاذان»; otherwise the readers' route stands.

reasons.claim: The chain is a single line of «حدثنا»/«عن» links ending at Ibn Abbas, who relates the Prophet's practice.
reasons.quote: عن الزهري، عن عبيد الله بن عبد الله، عن ابن عباس، قال

reasons.claim: The footnote number is not part of a name.
reasons.quote: أبو يحيى الحماني (2)

reasons.claim: «ح» opens a second branch, Ahmad b. Mani' from Yahya b. Zakariyya.
reasons.quote: ح وحدثنا أحمد بن منيع، عن يحيى بن زكريا

reasons.claim: The names after the branches are written once and shared by both routes, ending at Abu Sa'id.
reasons.quote: عن داود، عن أبي نضرة، عن أبي سعيد

reasons.claim: The dashed glosses and «قال أبو كامل» inside the matn add no link.
reasons.quote: - قال أبو كامل قال -

reasons.claim: The report writes its own full chain to A'isha and only refers to the wording with «بمثله».
reasons.quote: أخبرتني عمرة، أنها سمعت عائشة، تقول ‏.‏ بمثله

reasons.claim: The chain opens with Muhammad b. al-Muthanna from Abd al-Wahhab.
reasons.quote: وحدثناه محمد بن المثنى، حدثنا عبد الوهاب

reasons.claim: After Abd al-Azim the chain passes through the named Imam, his father, his forefathers, to Amir al-Mu'minin, who speaks.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَنْ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

reasons.claim: The stored chain omits the named Imam written in the chain.
reasons.quote: عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسَى

reasons.claim: Zuhayr and Abd b. Humayd are co-transmitters from one Ya'qub, whose fuller name follows in Zuhayr's wording.
reasons.quote: جميعا عن يعقوب، قال زهير حدثنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم

reasons.claim: The chain continues through the nephew and his uncle to Abu Hurayra, who quotes the Prophet.
reasons.quote: حدثنا ابن أخي ابن شهاب، عن عمه، قال أخبرني عروة بن الزبير، أن أبا هريرة

reasons.claim: The report opens directly with the saying and names no transmitter.
reasons.quote: وَ مَنْ صَلَّى فِي مَسْجِدِ مِنًى مِائَةَ رَكْعَةٍ

reviews.uncertainty_note: The opening «وَ» and closing quotation mark suggest a continuation of an earlier report, which the packet does not show.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters share one level from Sharik.
reasons.quote: حدثنا عثمان، وأبو بكر ابنا أبي شيبة ومحمد بن الصباح البزاز قالوا حدثنا شريك

reasons.claim: Shurayh asked A'isha and she answers, so she is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن أبيه، قال سألت عائشة

reasons.claim: Ibn al-Sabbah's remark on a word is a wording remark, not a route.
reasons.quote: قال ابن الصباح في حديثه محرمة
